# Third-party images LibreChat runs next to itself on AKS, copied into the dev
# registry (crseckubedev) under mirror/ by .github/workflows/aks-dev-image.yml:
# the cluster pulls only from its own registry. One per line:
#   <source reference>  <name:tag under crseckubedev.azurecr.io/mirror/>
# libre-chat-infra librechat/manifests/base pins the same tags; change
# both together. The upstream autopilot bumps these with the LibreChat version.

docker.io/getmeili/meilisearch:v1.12.3                  meilisearch:v1.12.3
